newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Taeyang Metal falls on prosecution probe.
newsitem.headline: Taeyang Metal falls on prosecution probe.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Taeyang Metal Industrial Co Ltd fell 4.1 percent in early trading on Tuesday after the Securities Supervisory Board asked prosecutors to investigate illegal trading in Taeyang shares, brokers said.
After opening at limit low of 38,200 won and then rebounding, Taeyang Metal was off 1,700 won at 39,800 by 0130 GMT.

The securities watchdog alleged a major shareholder, who also served as a vice president of the nation's largest nuts and bolts producer, and his broker at Hanil Securities had been involved in stock price manipulation.The prices of Taeyang's common share prices rose to 27,300 won from 17,400 and those of preferred stocks to 11,600 from 8,000 during this period.
"Investors are worrying the prosecution probe would give a further blow on the share prices," said an LG Securities broker. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
